page: Microsoft Azure D48pds_v5 is a general-purpose instance powered by the 64-bit ARM architecture. Built upon the Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 platform, the system provides 48 physical cores operating at 3.0 GHz with dedicated core allocation and a single thread per core. Memory capacity is provisioned at 192 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The processor features 64 KB L1 data cache and 1.0 MB L2 cache per core alongside 32 MB of shared L3 cache. Local storage is bundled directly into the configuration with 1,933 GB of fast solid-state disk capacity, and the server operates without dedicated GPU acceleration.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel throughput across multi-threaded applications. The instance recorded high results in multi-core CPU stress tests and delivered notable performance in Clang software compilation benchmarks at 39,488 points. In-memory data store testing highlights exceptional write capacity, sustaining 61.96 million Redis SET operations per second. Conversely, single-threaded metrics exhibit moderate to lower performance tiers, characterized by a single-core Geekbench score of 1,121 and reduced single-thread bzip3 decompression rates. Architectural limitations include the absence of x86-specific instruction sets such as AVX-512 or AMX, which affects large-model tensor acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D48pds_v5 leverages ARM silicon density to offer high physical core counts and integrated NVMe storage at competitive operational overhead compared to legacy architectures. The 48 dedicated physical cores minimize noisy-neighbor resource contention common in hyperthreaded virtual platforms. This profile is best aligned with scalable, horizontally partitioned workloads including distributed microservices, Redis caching tiers, CI/CD compilation pipelines, batch processing jobs, and databases benefiting from high local SSD throughput.
description: Microsoft Azure D48pds_v5 is an ARM64 general-purpose virtual machine powered by 48 dedicated Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 physical cores operating at 3.0 GHz. It features 192 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio, and includes 1,933 GB of integrated local solid-state storage. The platform omits discrete GPU hardware and x86 vector extensions. Performance evaluations reflect top-tier multi-threaded output, marked by strong Clang compilation results, robust multi-core CPU stress testing, and over 61 million Redis SET operations per second. However, single-core processing capabilities and single-threaded decompression show lower baseline scores. The dedicated core model delivers reliable performance density without hyperthreading overhead. D48pds_v5 is suited for multi-threaded backend services, CI/CD build environments, container orchestration clusters, and caching layers requiring local scratch storage.
